recomputed: All 31 SOURCES.tsv and 19 LOCAL_INPUTS.tsv sizes and SHA-256 values match. I parsed both article XMLs, the GEO and ENA records, count matrix, chicken gene-info and search responses, read the edgeR source and conference abstract, and checked both ZIP layers and the supplement’s Figshare MD5. A read-only replay reproduced analysis.json, both comparison and cohort TSVs, and LOCAL_INPUTS.tsv byte for byte. The two Table 5 copies agree on all 18 rows. The extracted 1,595-byte reference matches SHA-256 d2f33b8b62b575918da7cb4956d22d187a22d0f2f256c311b405ed5ae5db8c0e. The registered samples are the eight hour-two POAH libraries in 71 GEO records and 71 distinct ENA runs. Each arm has two females and two males. Rep_C identifies EHC and Rep_D controls at hour two. Across all 71 records each of Rep_A–Rep_F maps to one treatment-by-time group. The source has 30,108 Ensembl rows. The registered design has leverage 0.375, giving a raw CPM cutoff of 2.480818005082452 in at least three libraries and a minimum of 15 total counts. Of 30,080 fit-input features, 14,970 passed, 11,807 were published and 3,163 were hidden. The published IDs and all eight filtered library sizes match. Of 18 selected rows, seven are published local pairs, eight are tested under reserved IDs, and three fail the filter. OC3, MGP and MYO7L2 reached the cutoff in one, two and one libraries, with 59, 602 and 46 counts. Using deposited raw column totals, OC3 exceeded 1 CPM in 1/8 target and 5/71 series libraries, and MYO7L2 in 2/8 and 30/71. A separate join from the two source tables reproduced 7/7 same-sign effects, Pearson 0.9799142518840995, Spearman 1, median absolute difference 0.44115637690702947 and RMS difference 0.7219419686793984. Coverage is 7/18 (38.89%) of the selected list and 7/11,807 (0.0593%) of published local genes. The author’s printed FDRs span 0.06251–0.09889. Local paired nominal P spans 0.00362139–0.14826841 and FDR spans 0.28608199–0.69446535. At FDR <0.1 there are 18 selected author rows, one published local row (SOX14, 0.0510780774569692) and zero shared calls. Within pairs the counts are 7/7 and 0/7. At <0.05 neither published set contains a call. The sole printed |logFC| ≤1 is BEND3 (ENSGALG00010012529), −0.67962, nominal P 0.0000873, FDR 0.09889. I checked the registry, five ledgers and v2 policy. The existing selected-result spec covers this contrast, the dataset has no concordance override, and the selected comparison falls below both pair and coverage minima. The proposed ledger fields and enum values occur in the current ledgers. No row, sample, direction or threshold was chosen on the basis of agreement. The closure remains needs_author_contact, with no fully verified contrast.
problems: The contrast note placed sampling after the common heat challenge. Section 2.2 places the biopsies two hours from its start, during the day-four challenge. Section 2.1 describes a single conditioning incubator for each treatment. The correction makes the resulting treatment–setter confounding explicit for the design as reported and leaves independent replication across runs open.

The proposal called the test combination unspecified and summarized the publication rule as a 0.1 cutoff. Section 2.8 explicitly requires FDR ≤0.1 in both tests and |logFC| >1. Table 5’s footnote uses <0.1 and Figure S2’s caption uses >0.1. The choice between < and ≤ changes zero printed calls. Only 17/18 printed rows satisfy the stated magnitude condition. Which per-test statistics supplied the columns and how BEND3 entered the selected list remain unresolved.

The opening description could be read as saying eight genes lack published author coefficients. Table 5 prints coefficients for all 18. Eight fitted coefficients are absent specifically from the published local DE output. OC3 also has a reserved local identifier in addition to failing the expression filter.
